newsitem.title: USA: Former Dickstein partner starts Palestra Capital.
newsitem.headline: Former Dickstein partner starts Palestra Capital.

text.p: David Brail, a former partner and director of research at Dickstein Partners, said on Tuesday he had formed an investment firm called Palestra Capital LLC, specializing in event-driven opportunities.
"The firm will invest in opportunities created by corporate dislocations such as mergers, bankruptcies, re-capitalizations and special situations," Brail said in a statement.
Brail, 31, said Palestra's first fund would be launched in January 1997. He worked for Dickstein for nine years before resigning in early 1996.
